facts.fact: Togo Officiel reports that the Ministry of Digital Economy and Digital Transformation launched on 22 May 2025 the recruitment of a consultant to update the national digital transformation strategy as a new 'Togo Digital' strategy; it is being prepared, not yet issued.
The new 'Togo Digital' strategy is to cover 2025-2030, per Togo Officiel.
The ministry started recruiting a consultant on 22 May 2025 to write the successor strategy Togo Digital 2025-2030.

Togo Officiel says the current strategy, the country's first digital transformation strategy of about five years ago, ends at the end of 2025; the date used is the article's publication date, 2025-05-27.
